annotation.title_clean: 100 Days Mission to respond to future pandemic threats: Reducing the impact of future pandemics by making Diagnostics, Therapeutics and Vaccines available within 100 days
annotation.title_en: 100 Days Mission to respond to future pandemic threats: Reducing the impact of future pandemics by making Diagnostics, Therapeutics and Vaccines available within 100 days
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Pandemic Preparedness Partnership (report to the G7, UK Presidency)
annotation.summary_en: Independent report by the Pandemic Preparedness Partnership to the G7 (June 2021) proposing a 100 Days Mission to make diagnostics, therapeutics and vaccines available within 100 days of a pandemic threat. It sets out a roadmap on R&D, best practice between pandemics and equitable access. Unrelated to AI or robotics; the file is mislabelled as the AI for Science Strategy.
key_provisions_or_claims: Aim to have safe, effective, affordable diagnostics, therapeutics and vaccines within 100 days of a WHO-declared PHEIC.
Prioritise R&D on critical viral families and maintain diverse vaccine platforms.
Embed best practice and preparation between pandemics, including manufacturing and financing.
Agree 'rules of the road' on prioritisation, speed, scale and equitable access.
Document content does not match the metadata title 'AI for Science Strategy'.
